subject: Problem installing v2.3.0 on Mac OS X Mavericks

messages.author: d3319c088176ee7b
messages.subject: Problem installing v2.3.0 on Mac OS X Mavericks
parts:
You might recall that I had difficulty getting the last version of Stan to run on my MacBook. I was running into the same compilation error with v2.3.0, but I deleted -I/usr/local/include from CPPFLAGS in R's Makeconf file and the compile works fine. I also tested the schools example, and it worked too.

The problem arises because I have a version of Boost installed under /usr/local/include, the version I have is in some way incompatible with the version being used for RStan, and the compiler is finding the /usr/local/include version before it finds the one distributed with RStan.

I'm not sure how to fix that incompatibility for others who might encounter it, but it might be worth mentioning this in the documentation somewhere if there isn't a simple way around it.

Kent
